summary.text: Adam Nicoll is the Family First candidate for Hawthorn at the 2026 Victorian state election. His party page describes him as a natural therapist whose speciality is helping people quit smoking. He says parents should have more say over what their children learn at school, and he backs measures to ease living costs for families and support small business.

summary.text: Clive Crosby is Labor's candidate for Hawthorn, held by Liberal John Pesutto, at the 2026 Victorian election. The ABC says his work background is in hospitality. He was third on Labor's Southern Metropolitan upper house ticket in 2022 and ran for Labor in the federal seat of Kooyong in 2025. His party page stresses renting reforms and cheaper public transport.

summary.text: John Pesutto is the Liberal member for Hawthorn, a seat he held from 2014 to 2018 and won back in 2022. He led the Victorian Liberal Party, and was Leader of the Opposition, from December 2022 until he lost a leadership spill in December 2024. A lawyer, he is recontesting Hawthorn in 2026.

legal_and_integrity.text: Sued for defamation by Moira Deeming and two others over statements he made as Liberal leader in 2023.
legal_and_integrity.outcome: He settled two of the cases in May 2024 with an apology; in December 2024 the Federal Court found he had defamed Deeming and awarded her $300,000 damages.

legal_and_integrity.text: Ordered by the Federal Court to pay $2.3 million of Deeming's legal costs, and served with a bankruptcy notice when they went unpaid.
legal_and_integrity.outcome: The Victorian Liberal Party agreed in June 2025 to lend him $1.5 million so he would not be declared bankrupt.

summary.text: Kylie Rocha is the Greens candidate for Hawthorn at the 2026 Victorian election. She is a control systems engineer whose career has taken in Tesla's electric vehicle production in the United States as well as coal-fired power stations in the Latrobe Valley. The daughter of migrants from India and Sri Lanka, she was raised in Melbourne's south-east. She was fourth on the Greens' Southern Metropolitan upper house ticket in 2022.

summary.text: Shima Ibuki is an independent candidate for Hawthorn at the 2026 Victorian election. She has represented Maling Ward on Boroondara City Council since 2024 and became deputy mayor in November 2025. Her earlier career spanned more than ten years in superannuation and financial services and work in the community sector, where she managed the Surrey Hills Neighbourhood Centre and was president of Neighbourhood Houses Victoria. Her campaign site says she has received and disclosed a donation from Climate 200 supporters, and that she is making no preference deals.

summary.text: Tess McEnearney is standing for the Victorian Socialists in Hawthorn at the 2026 Victorian election. She works in medical research while doing a PhD on neurodegeneration. As an activist she has taken part in climate campaigns, protests over the war in Gaza and opposition to cuts to community health services.
